intake_method: Web or mobile form submitted by the prospect
expected_validation: Format checks, FSA resolvable to a CMA or provincial remainder, consent flag present
assignment_timing: Automatic routing when validated; assignment SLA SLA-04A
duplicate_handling: Screen against open leads and prospects; exact duplicates merged automatically
attribution_rule: Source touch CH-DIG with form identifier and optional campaign code
common_exceptions: Missing FSA; implausible employee band; bot or test submission

intake_method: Branch staff enter a referral for a walk-in or existing retail relationship
expected_validation: Referring branch code valid; consent recorded by branch
ownership_start: Routing queue with optional preferred RM named by branch
assignment_timing: Automatic routing; referral assignment SLA SLA-04B
duplicate_handling: Duplicate merges keep the branch source touch
attribution_rule: Source touch CH-BRN with referring branch code
common_exceptions: Named preferred RM at capacity; branch outside the lead's territory

intake_method: Response to an outbound or event campaign
expected_validation: Campaign code active on response date
assignment_timing: Batch routing within campaign SLA SLA-04C
duplicate_handling: High duplicate risk: always screened against existing leads
attribution_rule: Source touch CH-MKT with campaign code; first and all touches retained
common_exceptions: Expired campaign code; bulk upload errors

intake_method: Referral from an external partner (for example a fictional accountant or industry association)
expected_validation: Partner code active; referral acknowledgement sent to partner
assignment_timing: Automatic routing; referral assignment SLA SLA-04B
duplicate_handling: Duplicates keep the partner source touch for acknowledgement and outcome feedback
attribution_rule: Source touch CH-PTR with partner code
common_exceptions: Inactive partner code; partner refers an existing client

intake_method: Relationship manager records a self-sourced prospect
expected_validation: Prospecting RM active; territory consistent or manager-approved
assignment_timing: Immediate self-assignment if within capacity and territory, otherwise routed; assignment SLA SLA-04A
first_contact_expectation: First-contact SLA by priority band (SLA-06A..C; usually met at creation)
duplicate_handling: Screened; if a duplicate is owned by another RM it goes to duplicate review
attribution_rule: Source touch CH-RMP with prospecting RM
common_exceptions: Prospect already owned by another RM; RM at hard capacity
